title: recommendation-cards-change-timeline-and-safe-rollback-ux
creator: Ayesha Khan
description: Design and product spec for the Optimize Console's recommendation presentation, change-timeline, and safe apply/rollback UX. The goal is to make batching and caching recommendations actionable while minimizing risk: recommendation cards should surface estimated cost delta, latency impact, confidence, and suggested rollout strategy; staged-diff previews must let users inspect before/after configs and sample traffic simulation; apply history must be an immutable audit trail with a replayable timeline and one-click revert options (sandboxed by default). This ticket coordinates PM, Design, and Eng work to land the front-end screens, telemetry events, and audit entries needed for compliance and SRE debugging.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation card UI shows: title, short rationale, estimated cost delta (daily/monthly), estimated latency delta, confidence score, and recommended rollout (immediate/canary/schedule).
Clicking 'Preview changes' opens a staged-diff view showing side-by-side before/after config, token-level cost estimate, and a small simulated request stream demonstrating latency behavior.
Users can run a sandbox preview that applies the change to a non-production replicate (no live traffic) and see sample request outcomes and measured cost/latency metrics.

Apply flow requires a 2-step confirmation: (1) select rollout policy (full/canary/gradual) and optional schedule; (2) final confirmation records actor, diff-id, and generates an immutable audit entry.

Post-apply, Console shows an interactive timeline for that recommendation with events: generated, reviewed, sandbox-run, applied, canary metrics, and (if any) auto-rollback or manual rollback with reasons. Timeline entries link to logs/dashboards and the exact diff snapshot.

Audit trail item includes who applied the change, timestamps, diff snapshot (JSON), cost delta estimate, model/runtime versions, and a one-click 'revert' that creates a rollback diff and a separate audit record.
All UI actions emit telemetry events (recommendation.view, recommendation.preview, sandbox.run, recommendation.apply, recommendation.rollback) documented in the telemetry spec.
Security/compliance: applied diff snapshots are stored in the customer's audit log retention and are retrievable for export via the Console.
